about_the_game:
Helping ghosts find peace wasn’t in the lighthouse job description. But here we are.

Greta Sees Ghosts! is a cozy, hand-drawn puzzle adventure full of quirky spirits, challenging shape-based puzzles, sharply funny dialogue (trust us!), and quietly emotional moments. Help the dearly but not entirely departed move on, one strange little quest at a time.

As lighthouse keeper Greta, you’ll explore a chain of remote North Sea islands, collecting ghosts in your magical oil lamp and chatting with them along the way. They're stuck somewhere between life, death, and mild delusion. And Greta’s the one stuck helping them sort it out.

In the demo you will meet a stressed-out businessman who forgot how to stop optimizing – even in the afterlife. In the full game, you'll encounter many more lost souls, like a grandma whose lapdog now runs with wolves, or a passionate artist who’s more upset about her final masterpiece being used as a door than about being, you know, dead.

Each encounter reveals not only the ghosts' stories but also Greta's own quiet journey.

Scope of the Demo

In the demo, you explore the first two islands of the game. You start on Greta’s lighthouse rock and then unlock a second, larger island.
Greta’s notebook leads you to your first ghost, whom you can set free. On the second island, you’ll come across clues pointing to four more lost souls. One of these ghosts is also waiting for your help in the demo.

Hand-Drawn Island Adventure & Quirky Characters

Explore a richly illustrated open world filled with shape-based puzzles. Unlock new islands, and gather hitchhiking ghosts and their stories in your magical lamp.

Narrative Puzzles

Solve shape-based puzzles tightly woven into each character’s story — meaningful, satisfying, and never just for the sake of it.

Quirky Encounters

Meet an unforgettable cast of characters with wishes, regrets, and strange little habits. Witty, playful, and just a bit morbid — conversations that would make Death chuckle.


Greta Sees Ghosts! invites you into a whimsical world where every ghost has a tale, and every puzzle brings you closer to understanding what it means to let go.
